English.prompt_guidance: Use clear South African English and preserve the requested professional register.
English.reviewer_requirement: A proficient technical editor must approve edited English.

Afrikaans.prompt_guidance: Use standard contemporary South African Afrikaans. Prefer natural professional phrasing over literal English word order.
Afrikaans.reviewer_requirement: A proficient Afrikaans language reviewer must approve the complete translation.

isiZulu.prompt_guidance: Use standard contemporary South African isiZulu orthography and natural concords. Do not force English sentence structure or invent technical terminology; flag uncertain domain terms.
isiZulu.reviewer_requirement: A proficient isiZulu language reviewer with relevant domain knowledge must approve the complete translation.

Sesotho.reviewer_requirement: A proficient Sesotho language reviewer with relevant domain knowledge must approve the complete translation.
